# sendfees.com

> What does it cost to send a stablecoin? Read from the chains, not quoted: the median fee of real, plain USDC or USDT transfers on each of 46 chains, in US dollars at the hour they were read, each with its transaction. Read 19 Oct 2026 – 20 Oct 2026.

A plain transfer is one ordinary account sending the coin straight to another, succeeding, and doing nothing else. Transfers through smart wallets, relayers and other contracts, failed ones, and anything that also swaps, bridges or pays out in batches are left out and counted by reason. A transfer to a wallet that held none of the coin costs more and is kept apart as a first-time transfer. Where some senders pay nothing — prepaid energy on Tron, gasless transfers on Sui, a sponsor or relayer paying the gas — the figure is what a sender paying its own fee pays, and the share that paid less is given beside it. Figures are written out in full, two significant digits.

## Results

- [data.json](https://sendfees.com/data.json): every row as data — the figure, its basis, the window, who paid less, the first-time figure, the median transaction, and every sampled transaction with its fee and explorer link
